datasheet_identity.title: MM3Z2V0 THRU MM3Z75 Surface Mount Zener Diodes

extraction_notes: MM3Z3V0 table row gives VZ minimum 2.8 V, nominal 3.0 V, maximum 3.2 V at IZT = 5 mA; ZZT maximum 100 ohm at IZT = 5 mA; ZZK maximum 1000 ohm at IZK = 0.5 mA; IR maximum 10 uA at VR = 1.0 V.
The datasheet has no scalar junction-capacitance table entry and no reverse-recovery-time entry; capacitance is therefore null and reverse recovery is null.

The plotted characteristics are family-level curves. The zener plot shown is a representative trace and does not include a dedicated MM3Z3V0 label; this applicability limitation is retained rather than treating the plotted trace as an exact MM3Z3V0 curve.
The electrical-characteristics table also lists typical temperature coefficient at IZTC = 5 mA as -3.5 to 0 mV/degC for MM3Z3V0; this field has no corresponding slot in the extraction schema.
